OmniTune 1.0 is officially here.

After months of development, testing, redesigns, bug fixes, and countless improvements, OmniTune 1.0 has officially been released.

This is the first major stable release of OmniTune and marks an important milestone for the project.

## What OmniTune 1.0 brings

- Fast and reliable music playback
- Search for songs, albums, artists, and playlists
- Offline downloads
- Liked songs and custom playlists
- Synced lyrics
- Queue management and continuous playback
- Multiple audio quality modes
- Dynamic artwork-based theming
- Improved background playback and media controls
- A redesigned and polished user experience
- Numerous performance, stability, and quality-of-life improvements

This release represents everything OmniTune has become so far, but 1.0 is only the beginning. Development will continue with new features, deeper personalization, better discovery, further platform support, and continuous improvements across the entire experience.

Thank you to everyone who tested OmniTune, reported issues, shared feedback, or simply followed the project along the way.

Welcome to OmniTune 1.0.

Version: 1.0.0
Status: Released

-- OmniTune
